label: Early brain changes in Lyme disease are associated with clinical outcomes.
summary: In Lyme disease (LD), 10-20 % of patients develop persistent symptoms following antibiotic treatment (i.e., post-treatment Lyme disease (PTLD)), which often includes neurological symptoms. This study tested the hypothesis that physiological brain changes occur early in LD and influence outcomes. Task-based functional MRI (fMRI) and health surveys were administered to patients with acute LD (n = 20) after treatment and six months later.
